events.title: 웨스트햄 유나이티드 sign striker David Kelly from 월솔 for £600,000. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 sign defender Andy Thorn from FA Cup winners 윔블던 for a club record £850,000.
Graham Roberts returns to England in a £470,000 move to 첼시 from 레인저스.

The first North London derby to be held at Wembley Stadium ends in a 4–0 victory for 아스널 in the friendly Wembley International Tournament . The Gunners' goalscorers are Paul Merson , Alan Smith , and Brian Marwood (2).
아스널 beat 바이에른 뮌헨 3–0 to win the Wembley International Tournament on goal difference.
노팅엄 포리스트 sign England midfielder Steve Hodge from 토트넘 홋스퍼 for £550,000.
After an unhappy season at 유벤투스 , Ian Rush returns to 리버풀 for £2.8 million. It is the third time in two months that the national transfer fee record has been broken.

리버풀 gain revenge for their FA Cup final defeat by 윔블던 in May by beating them 2–1 in the Charity Shield . John Aldridge , who missed a penalty in the FA Cup final, scores both goals for 리버풀, and John Fashanu scores for 윔블던.
Kevin Moran leaves 맨체스터 유나이티드 on a free transfer after ten years and joins Spanish side Sporting Gijón .
The Faroe Islands record their first international victory , defeating Canada 1–0.
Alan Ball prepares 포츠머스 's challenge for an immediate return to the First Division by paying 애스턴 빌라 £315,000 for striker Warren Aspinall .

밀월 begin their life as a First Division side by drawing 2–2 at 애스턴 빌라. Forwards John Aldridge , Alan Smith, and Tony Cottee score opening day hat-tricks as 리버풀 beat 찰턴 애슬레틱 3–0, 아스널 thrash FA Cup holders 윔블던 5–1, and 에버턴 thump 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 4–0. 토트넘 홋스퍼's opening fixture at home to 코번트리 시티 was postponed following the Londoners' failure to obtain a safety certificate for White Hart Lane .
노리치 시티 sign Irish midfielder Andy Townsend from 사우샘프턴 for £300,000. 첼시 defender Steve Wicks retires from playing due to a back injury.
